long_description:
Calling all Allied Health and Nursing students!

 With finals quickly approaching, you deserve to stretch, relax and enjoy an evening of res

About this Event

Allied Health and Nursing students are invited to take a well-deserved break before finals with an evening focused on relaxation, restoration, and connection.
Join us on December 2, 2026 from 5–7 p.m. at the James S. McDonnell Planetarium for a unique experience under the stars. This free event will feature a guided star show, an indoor beginner-friendly yoga session, and opportunities to connect with the BJC Careers team.
Take time to recharge, unwind, and connect with peers in a calming and inspiring environment designed just for you.

Info: BJC Careers staff will be on-site to network and answer any questions students might have about opportunities for students and graduates at BJC HealthCare. 

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in St. Louis.
